name: Community policing

subjectOf.text: The CRDAO governance model enables a community policing and audit methodology for code reviews, and those governance and policing functions ensure less duplication of code reviews.
subjectOf.abstract: The CRDAO also uses a community policing and audit methodology for code reviews. This is enabled by the CRDAO governance model. Moreover, the CRDAO governance and policing functions ensure less duplication of code reviews.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, How DAOs Optimize Open-Source Code Reviews and Create Open-Source Standards (2021). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3995709
scope_conditions: DAO based governance over a reviewer community

subjectOf.text: DAO governance and policing functions reduce duplication of code reviews, so decentralized community policing substitutes for the redundant parallel work that centralized platforms use to assure quality.
subjectOf.abstract: the CRDAO governance and policing functions ensure less duplication of code reviews.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, AI Learning - Decentralized Governance to Optimize Human Output Datasets for AI Learning (2024). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=4755632
scope_conditions: applies to reviews conducted under the CRDAO governance model
